text:
Elena Gomez: Heads-up: NexaSpark preview cohort - 12 of 30 seats haven't finished the quickstart checklist. Their onboarding workshop is Fri. CRM heatmap shows low token usage. Thinking we should run a short pre-workflow to avoid attrition.
Samir Khan: Agreed. Proposal: two-wave outreach. Wave A = targeted 1:1 pings to account champions. Wave B = a 3-qs micro-survey + one-click 15m slot for blockers. I'll own Wave A.
Jade Liu: I'll own the micro-survey + email copy. Keep it <4 questions, mobile-friendly. We should include a checkbox for "need an API snippet" so we can route to Eng DO.
Elena Gomez: Good call. Also add a KB link for common pitfalls and a tiny checklist they can complete in minutes.
OnboardBot: Reminder: follow_up_deadline set for 1753270000.
Samir Khan: Quick note: two accounts are integrating via the SDK; they may need sample env var configs and a sanity-test curl. I'll attach samples after this thread.
Jade Liu: Draft micro-survey below:
---
NexaSpark QuickSetup Check (3 Qs, ~30s)
1) Which best describes you? (a) Admin/setup (b) Dev integrating API (c) Evaluator/PM (d) Other
2) Main blocker right now? (a) missing docs (b) permissions/keys (c) errors/bugs (d) time
3) Want a 15m pre-workshop help call? (Yes/No) + optional short note
---
Elena Gomez: Love it. Please include a direct link to the Troubleshooting KB and a calendar link. Also, set internal KPI: survey response >=20% within 48h, and product usage +15% by next Monday to clear renewal risk.
Jade Liu: Email nudge copy:
"Hi — quick 30s check. We noticed the quickstart isn't complete. Could you fill this 3-question survey: [link]? If you'd like help, book a 15m slot: [calendar]. Cheers, Jade"

Samir Khan: Sample env snippet for SDK teams:
```
# env example
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-test-XXXXX
export REDWOOD_ENV=preview
# quick test
python -c "from redwood import Client; c=Client(); print(c.generate('hello'))"
```
Elena Gomez: Assign tags in CRM: nexaspark_preview, onboarding_incomplete, outreach_wave1. Samir please mark accounts you pinged.
OnboardBot: Task created: owner=Samir Khan, due=1753230000.
Rakesh (CS Manager): Thanks team. If survey results show repeated "missing docs" answers, escalate to Docs and Eng with examples. Keep this thread updated with cadence and any workshop cancellations.
Samir Khan: Pinged 10 champions, got 3 quick replies. One asked for an API snippet (sent). Will post when I hit 6 responses.
Jade Liu: Survey link live. First 8 responses show 50% "time" and 25% "missing docs". Flagging potential docs gap.
Elena Gomez: Ok hold a 10m sync after Friday workshop to collect feedback and translate into Optimize recommendations (batching vs sample prompts).
Samir Khan: Noted. I'll also add a follow-up note for any accounts that opt into the 15m help call.
Rakesh (CS Manager): Good. If usage doesn't move by the next review, we prep a renewal playbook for risk accounts. For now, focus on unblockers. :muscle:
